notes.scope: Active source Note IDs returned by the Zoho CRM Notes records API and compared with local source-derived Note IDs in the same audit run
notes.source_count_endpoint_status: Observed from the Notes count endpoint during the same audit run; its scope exceeds active enumeration by 150 rows
notes.parity_basis: Same-epoch GET-only source enumeration and SELECT-only local ID-set comparison
notes.content_comparison: The current audit compared active ID sets only; one previously reconciled Note has historical exact-payload verification

attachments.scope: Source attachment metadata IDs and declared byte totals; attachment bodies were not downloaded

related_lists.scope: Source related-list definitions compared with locally mirrored metadata and generic Related-tab structural resolution
related_lists.unresolved_behavior: Unresolved definitions return availability=unresolved with a reason code and are labelled unavailable by the UI; only availability=queryable may be reported as verified empty
